shared_harness.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

methodology: Every retained input configuration; old Cedar/current Cedar/Flecs run sequentially, equal-length copied paths, rotated/reversed order and crossed environment paddings. Two discarded warmups per method/case. Identical operation counts and checksums; shared frozen kernels and one generated main object per suite. Any bounded iteration-limit change is recorded in the shared harness manifest. Adaptive untimed calibration targets the fastest implementation. No sample deletion.
